description: The :605-611 WHEN DFHRESP(NOTFND) arm of STARTBR-TRANSACT-FILE, reached as NOTFND specifically and over a file that demonstrably had twelve records to offer. Twelve seeded rows cannot produce it: :207 moves LOW-VALUES into TRAN-ID, so the STARTBR at :593-600 positions at the boundary and succeeds, which is why the outcome is declared in forcedOutcomes.startBrowse rather than arranged. Being a separate case from case05 is the point - NOTFND and ENDFILE are different CICS conditions that common.FileStatus keeps distinct, and TransactionMenuController.positionArmOf folds both onto one arm; a fold is only worth asserting if both of its inputs are actually driven, so the observable outcome here is deliberately identical to case05's while the file underneath is not empty. The path: :107 finds EIBCALEN at 218 rather than zero, so :111 copies the commarea; :112 finds NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER, so :113 sets it - the request carries CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT 0 and the response returns 1 - :114 moves LOW-VALUES into COTRN0AO, :115 performs PROCESS-ENTER-KEY and :116 performs SEND-TRNLST-SCREEN. No RECEIVE happens on this path, because :118 is the other arm of that IF, so the EVALUATE EIBAID at :119-134 is never entered and mapFields is empty: the attention identifier travels in the payload and selects nothing here. Inside PROCESS-ENTER-KEY the LOW-VALUES of :114 leave every SEL000nI unset, so the ten-way EVALUATE TRUE at :148-182 selects nothing; :206 finds TRNIDINI at LOW-VALUES; :221 puts the cursor on TRNIDINL; and :224 moves ZERO into CDEMO-CT00-PAGE-NUM before :225 performs PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD. The forced arm then sets TRANSACT-EOF, moves 'You are at the top of the page...' into WS-MESSAGE, repositions the cursor and sends - and never moves 'Y' into WS-ERR-FLG, which is its only difference from the WHEN OTHER arm at :612-618 that case07 drives. Because the error flag stays off, :283 lets the rest of the paragraph run: :285's guard is FALSE for DFHENTER so the skip read at :286 does not fire; :289 is FALSE so the blanking loop at :290-292 is skipped over a row block :114 has already blanked; :295 leaves WS-IDX at one and the loop at :297 never executes its body, so :301 never runs; and :305 is FALSE so the ELSE at :314 runs - :315 sets NEXT-PAGE-NO and :316 finds WS-IDX > 1 FALSE, leaving the page number at the zero :224 moved in. An unconditional increment at :317-318 would advertise page one over a list that painted no row. THREE sends, in this order: :611 from the position arm, :326 after ENDBR at :322, and :116, which MAIN-PARA performs unconditionally after PROCESS-ENTER-KEY on the first-entry path - so this path sends once more than PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD does on its own, and the last send repaints the same screen with WS-MESSAGE unchanged. WS-MESSAGE is never cleared between them, so all three carry the same line, and both channels pin it: eighty bytes as WS-MESSAGE holds it and the leading seventy-eight as :531 truncates it into ERRMSGO. :324 moves the page number into PAGENUMI of COTRN0AI, the input item rather than PAGENUMO, an inherited oddity preserved rather than tidied. The seed is case01's canonical twelve rows verbatim, each arithmetically 350 bytes with the CVTRA05Y FILLER X(20) at 330-349 emitted as spaces and TRAN-AMT an eleven-byte zoned span whose sign is overpunched in its trailing byte at scale two; US-ASCII is named rather than defaulted, and the clock is pinned at 2022-07-19T23:12:34 so that CURDATEO and CURTIMEO are expectations rather than readings of the host. No send pins an attribute, because the program moves none: it copies DFHBMSCA at :81 and never uses it, and it copies neither CSSETATY nor CSSTRPFY. The class is named TransactionMenuController by mandate, but :5 reads 'Function : List Transactions from TRANSACT file' - the program LISTS transactions and is not a menu, so the name comes from the mandate and every value here from the source. Provenance: statically derived by reading app/cbl/COTRN00C.cbl paragraph by paragraph against app/cpy/CVTRA05Y.cpy, app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy, app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy, app/cpy-bms/COTRN00.CPY, app/bms/COTRN00.bms and app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD. It was never captured from a running COBOL program, because executing the legacy programs is impossible in this environment.
